title: Hesperidin attenuates lipopolysaccharide-induced endometritis by inhibiting mitochondrial oxidative stress via activating the AMPK/PGC-1alpha signalling pathway.
authors: Wu, Linfang; Wang, Jing; Yan, Yonghuan; Wang, Lu; Huang, Qi; Peng, Jinyong; Li, Lili
one_liner_zh: 该文研究橙皮苷通过AMPK/PGC-1alpha通路缓解LPS诱导的子宫内膜炎，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合研究无关。
abstract: Endometritis is a prevalent condition of the reproductive system that leads to significant tissue damage in the uterus, thereby seriously impacting the health and quality of life of these patients. Hesperidin (HES), a natural flavonoid glycoside, displays various biological activities. Nonetheless, the protective effect of HES treatment against endometritis remains uncertain. In this study, we examined the protective effects of HES on endometritis induced by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) both in vivo and in vitro. In vitro experimental results showed that HES reduced the levels of inflammatory factors, improved mitochondrial morphology, increased mitochondrial activity and inhibited ROS levels; moreover, it activated the AMPK/PGC-1 alpha signalling pathway in LPS-induced human endometrial endothelial cells (HEECs). AMPK served as a potential target of HES, which was further validated using molecular docking, molecular dynamic simulation, CETSA and SPR. Moreover, in vivo experimental results indicated that HES significantly mitigated the histopathological alterations in the uterus caused by LPS, as well as reduced the levels of inflammatory factors, MPO activity, the expression levels of CD38, and CD138 and activated the AMPK/PGC-1alpha signalling pathway. Overall, HES mitigated mitochondrial oxidative stress and inflammatory response primarily through activation of the AMPK/PGC-1alpha signalling pathway, thereby exerting protective effects against endometritis.
abstract_zh: 子宫内膜炎是生殖系统的一种常见疾病，会导致子宫组织显著损伤，从而严重影响患者的健康和生活质量。橙皮苷（HES）是一种天然黄酮苷，具有多种生物活性。然而，HES治疗对子宫内膜炎的保护作用仍不明确。在本研究中，我们考察了HES对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的子宫内膜炎在体内和体外的保护作用。体外实验结果表明，HES降低了炎症因子水平，改善了线粒体形态，增加了线粒体活性，并抑制了ROS水平；此外，它还激活了LPS诱导的人子宫内膜内皮细胞（HEECs）中的AMPK/PGC-1α信号通路。AMPK作为HES的潜在靶点，通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、CETSA和SPR进一步验证。此外，体内实验结果表明，HES显著减轻了LPS引起的子宫组织病理学改变，并降低了炎症因子水平、MPO活性、CD38和CD138的表达水平，同时激活了AMPK/PGC-1α信号通路。总体而言，HES主要通过激活AMPK/PGC-1α信号通路来缓解线粒体氧化应激和炎症反应，从而对子宫内膜炎发挥保护作用。
